preamble: The voiceless retroflex stop [ʈ] is lenited to the voiced retroflex flap [ɽ] between vowels. Yele (Yélî Dnye), a Papuan isolate of Rossel Island, reduces /ʈ/ to a flap [ɽ] between vowels.

examples.note: Listed as an allophone of /ʈ/ between vowels.
From the phonemic vs. phonetic transcription of the sample text in Wikipedia's Yele article.

sources: Levinson, S. C. (2022). A Grammar of Yélî Dnye: The Papuan Language of Rossel Island. De Gruyter Mouton. https://doi.org/10.1515/9783110733853
